IS 10250 : 1982 Specification for Environmental Test for Automotive Electrical EquipmentUDC 621.31 : 629.13.066 : 620.193TED11Reaffirmed 20211 Scope1.1 This standard specifies the basic information on degrees of severities for various environmental tests required to be conducted on automotive electrical equipment.1.2 This standard deals only with the severities of test conditions and gives no information on electrical and mechanical checks to be made or performance requirements during or after the test, or about the expected life of the equipment. For these requirements, relevant equipment specification shall be referred.1.3 The applicability of an environmental test and the sequence of tests shall be as given in the individual specifications.2
